text: Final diagnostic court now has all six local gates passing on the finalized source: documentation, focused first-level, scientific coverage, compileAll, testAll, and performance receipt validation. The JDK-22 formatter check also exposed is-terminal 0.1.1's malformed multi-release entry (versions/22 classfile major 67); project/plugins.sbt pins corrected 0.1.2, and the focused gate is green. docs/release-report.json validates and records every local gate pass, but remains intentionally blocked by the dirty checkout, dirty benchmark receipt eligibility, and missing external branch-protection, remote-CI, and reference-regeneration URLs. P4.4 must remain open until a clean committed court supplies those external receipts.
